title: docs: post-cloud-split README + CHANGELOG cleanup
body:
Follow-up to #1257. Removes the two stale rows in the README's package tables and adds an Unreleased CHANGELOG entry documenting the extraction.

No code changes.

- Tag `pre-cloud-split` (already pushed) marks the pre-split anchor.
- `apps/objectos` stays in framework; only `apps/cloud` + `@objectstack/service-cloud` moved to objectstack-ai/cloud.
